title: Layout of favorites grid is not synced after cloning
line: A cloned panel's Application Launcher now shows its favorites in the same order as the original.
explanation: Kickoff, Kicker and Application Dashboard save their favorites ordering in kactivitymanagerd-statsrc under their applet id, not in the applet's config. Cloning a panel copies the config but not that entry, so the cloned launcher had no ordering and fell back to a guess that takes another launcher instance's order, often a different or deleted one. Christoph Wolk's open MRs !6632 and !3730 make the shell pass the old applet id to the new launcher when cloning a panel or switching launcher alternatives, and the launcher copies the old id's ordering groups to its own. On top of them, two small changes are suggested on !6632: copy each group to the same activity instead of through saveOrdering() (which also overwrote the global group), and fix the launcher check that used indexOf() as a boolean.

commits.message:
applets/kicker, shell: fix the favorites ordering import and launcher check

Importing an ordering wrote every activity's order to the global group
too, leaving global as whichever came last, and the launcher check used
indexOf() as a boolean. Copy each group as is and fix that check.

BUG: 514303

Christoph Wolk's two commits from !3730, unchanged:
applets/kicker: import from old applet id onExternalData
applets/kickoff: import from old applet id onExternalData

patches.diff:
From be1e254428ca656f36c48bf90785229eb4d652e7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Christoph Wolk <cwo.kde@posteo.net>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:51:20 +0200
Subject: [PATCH 1/2] applets/kicker: import from old applet id onExternalData

Kicker (and dash) store extra data that relies on the applet's id
ouside appletsrc (more specifically in kactivitymanagerd-statsrc).
Without having the old applet id, the ordering of favorites may be lost
when replacing with an alternative or cloning the panel.

We now pass this id as an external argument when replacing or cloning,
so we can forward it to the backend onExternalData and import things
there.
---
 applets/kicker/main.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/main.qml b/applets/kicker/main.qml
index 5c71937b15..83f1fee270 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/main.qml
@@ -39,6 +39,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Plasmoid.icon: Plasmoid.configuration.useCustomButtonImage ? Plasmoid.configuration.customButtonImage : Plasmoid.configuration.icon
 
+    onExternalData: (mimetype, pluginId) => globalFavorites.importOrderingFromApplet(pluginId, Plasmoid.id, "org.kde.plasma.kicker")
+
     onSystemFavoritesChanged: {
         if (systemFavorites) {
             systemFavorites.favorites = Plasmoid.configuration.favoriteSystemActions;
-- 
2.53.0


From 17cf8e8cfbe0b9d6032696f6bd24fa6231ab9996 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Christoph Wolk <cwo.kde@posteo.net>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:52:11 +0200
Subject: [PATCH 2/2] applets/kickoff: import from old applet id onExternalData

Kickoff stores extra data that relies on the applet's id ouside
appletsrc (more specifically in kactivitymanagerd-statsrc). Without
having the old applet id, the ordering of favorites may be lost when
replacing with an alternative or cloning the panel.

We now pass this id as an external argument when replacing or cloning,
so we can forward it to the backend onExternalData and import things
there.
---
 applets/kickoff/main.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.qml b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
index 6b6c95dabe..e04e643666 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
@@ -184,6 +184,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     readonly property int minimumGridRowCount: Math.min(Screen.desktopAvailableWidth, Screen.desktopAvailableHeight) * Screen.devicePixelRatio < KickoffSingleton.gridCellSize * 4 + (fullRepresentationItem ? fullRepresentationItem.normalPage.preferredSideBarWidth : KickoffSingleton.gridCellSize * 2) ? 2 : 4
     //END
 
+    onExternalData: (mimetype, pluginId) => rootModel.favoritesModel.importOrderingFromApplet(pluginId, Plasmoid.id, "org.kde.plasma.kickoff")
+
     Plasmoid.icon: Plasmoid.configuration.icon
 
     preferredRepresentation: compactRepresentation
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: the original Kickoff shows Dolphin, Discover, System Settings, Chrome; the clone made with Clone Panel shows Discover first, the order of a stale launcher instance.
With !6632 (plus the suggested changes) and !3730: the clone shows the same order as the original.
